SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("total_jobs_submitted"))
FROM "jobs_submitted_-_flemish_institutions"
WHERE $timeFilter AND (("is_vib_data_core" =~ /^${vib_data_core:raw}$/) AND ("institution" =~ /^$institution$/))
GROUP BY time(30d), "institution"::tag fill(0)

targets.query: SELECT SUM("job_count") AS "jobs" FROM "jobs_by_state_-_flemish_institutions" WHERE $timeFilter AND (("is_vib_data_core" =~ /^${vib_data_core:raw}$/) AND ("institution" =~ /^$institution$/)) GROUP BY time($__interval), "state"::tag fill(0)

SELECT SUM("job_count") AS "jobs" FROM "jobs_by_state_-_vib_centers" WHERE $timeFilter AND (("is_vib_data_core" =~ /^${vib_data_core:raw}$/) AND ("vib_domain" =~ /^$vib_domain$/)) GROUP BY time($__interval), "state"::tag fill(0)

SELECT SUM("jobs_executed") AS "Executed", SUM("jobs_never_executed") AS "Never executed" FROM "jobs_executed_-_flemish_institutions" WHERE $timeFilter AND (("is_vib_data_core" =~ /^${vib_data_core:raw}$/) AND ("institution" =~ /^$institution$/)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)
